character.name: Nazar Battu
character.description: a traditional blue-and-white glass nazar battu (evil eye charm): a round flat disc with concentric blue, white, and black circles resembling a watchful eye, a small metallic loop at the top for hanging, sometimes framed with tiny beads, used across many cultures as a protective charm against the evil eye

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
